description:
Every name reachable as vaft.process.<name> before issue #249 made the namespace lazy, captured by importing the eager package on develop and reading its __dict__.
'defined_by' names the process submodules whose own source binds the name; 'owned' is true when at least one does. A name with owned=false reached this namespace by accident: six submodules (profile, equilibrium, electromagnetics, numerical, magnetics, statistical_analysis) declare no __all__, so their star-import surface is everything they import, and vaft/process/profile.py does 'from omas import *'.
test/test_process_lazy_namespace.py reads this file: every name here must either still resolve on vaft.process or appear in its REMOVED map naming the module that really provides it.
